question: Rahul started from his home to go to a park. He went 50 metres towards the East, then turned towards the South and walked 10 metres. He then turned right and walked for 40 metres. Finally, he turned to his right and walked 20 metres to reach the park. In which direction is his house from the park? (All turns are 90° turns only)
solution:
Rahul started from his home to go to a park. 

 
• He went 50 metres towards the East.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c06b092e318d87122471f74067f936a92b935b96b23dd8d9c9a0e049cd34aee5.png] 

 
• Then turned towards the South and walked 10 metres.
